dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, no EXEC SQL/CICS
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE100PARA ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — specifically public injury/illness receipt (公害レセプト, outpatient) with diagnosis-category point aggregation
purpose.summary: ORCR1010 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that processes public-hazard (公害) outpatient insurance claim receipts. It reads indexed receipt detail files (RECE100/120/130), aggregates diagnosis-category points, and writes or rewrites receipt records, handling numerous Japanese NHI revision rules across many maintenance versions from 2007 to 2015.

notable_features: 28 COPY statements with REPLACING for parameterised copybooks
INDEXED file organisation with DYNAMIC access on multiple files
Large flag and counter working-storage areas (FLG-AREA, CNT-AREA, IDX-AREA)
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3
199 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
Long revision history spanning 2007–2015 with named maintainers (NACL)
verdict.notes: Source comments are encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake in the archived text. The file is 5697 lines and clearly production medical-billing software. Truncated at 16000 chars but enough structure is visible to classify with high confidence.
